accepted_boundary_semantics.actorTime: Omitted start/end are0/duration; exit exclusive except end==global duration is inclusive at the final frame
accepted_boundary_semantics.actorMap: Omitted free-actor mapId means all active maps; omitted bound-instance mapId means initial document map only
accepted_boundary_semantics.background: Last row with time<=t is active; exact row time switches and is the fade-black midpoint; director clock freezes while old operation releases, real map travels/readiness resolves and fresh operation reacquires
accepted_boundary_semantics.anchor: Background anchor overrides whole document anchor; otherwise whole anchor. UI helper seeds different maps with zero anchor unless explicitly provided.
accepted_boundary_semantics.localMedia: MFCP1 newline binary package, uint32LE header length; sceneJSON<=512KiB, header<=1MiB,8audio maximum,16MiB per audio,64MiB total; local:sha256 IDs and exact binary SHA mandatory; no URLs/base64 in scene
accepted_boundary_semantics.mediaAPIs: createCinematicMediaStore({indexedDB,memory:false}); explicit memory:true fixture only. addAudio/get/put/remove; exportCinematicProject(document,{store}); importCinematicProject(file,{store})
accepted_boundary_semantics.audioAPIs: createCinematicAudioTimeline({audio,manifest,store,baseUrl}); prepare(document,{signal}), sample(document,time,{playing,seeking}), emit, stop,dispose,inspect; existing lease audio/context only

known_integration_seams: Actual main map prepare directly increments generation and cancels the live lease before Game.leaveMap. Root plans release old operation before travel, retain director only under internal flag, and reacquire after actual ready.
Old verification fixtures manually swapped terrain/mapId; that is insufficient evidence for background transitions. New map gate must exercise production resource/streaming loader.
Audio/media cannot own a second AudioContext or RAF; late decode or map/lease completion must not resurrect stopped voices.
Borrowed scene objects require full matrix/resource/render-policy restoration, not position-only snapshots.
Future catalog registration must be tested with an unrecognized synthetic manifest rather than another entry in a hardcoded list.
limits: Node/NullEngine and declared DOM/WebAudio/cache/image boundaries do not prove browser pixels, actual audio output, GPU resource use or device FPS.
Actual shipped geometry and runtime map policy must remain intact; fixture image substitution must be disclosed separately from rendered visual quality.
